sources.title: Ego-Pi: VLA Fine-Tuning for Ego-Centric Human and Robot Data
sources.snippet: Towards this end, we investigate key design choices for learning across human and humanoid embodiments equipped with dexterous five-finger hands, using the Pi0.5 model as a foundation. Our results show that human data enables robots to learn new task semantics and compose existing skills into novel behaviors without corresponding robot data.
